question: Who becomes free from bondage after practicing the ochre robe for six months?
premises: Six months of practice is prescribed.
The practitioner wears the ochre robe.
inference: The verse links six months of ochre-robe practice to freedom from bondage.
uncertainties: Whether ṣaṇmāsād means after or within six months.
plain_english: Whoever practices for six months, wearing the ochre robe free from bondage.
